newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 600 MW firm, peak power, raises prices.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 600 MW firm, peak power, raises prices.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 600 megawatts of firm power during heavy load hours on Thursday and raised prices by $2.50 per megawatt hour (MWh), the federal agency said Wednesday.
BPA had offered 400 MW of firm, on-peak power for Wednesday schedulings. The agency continued to refrain from offering power during light-load hours. Nor did they offer any non-firm power.

For Thursday, BPA offered firm power during heavy load hours (0700-2200 PST) at $32.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries, up from $29.50 for Wednesday. California-Oregon border deliveries were offered at $32.75, up from $30.25.
